name: Class buffs: the Spellwarding cooldown stacks with the all-resistance buffs
contract: Maintainer decision 2026-11-22 (PR #13237 review): a buff of five minutes or longer keeps one per stat
across classes; a shorter buff whose tooltip says it does not stack with similar effects is a support buff
and keeps one per stat among support buffs; every other shorter buff is a cooldown, has no CoA class
category and stacks with everything. Rite of Perseverance 575839 (Reaper, class 30) and Call of the
Lightning 575843 (Stormbringer, class 16) are 30 minute buffs, SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE_EXCLUSIVE on all
magic schools (misc 126), base points 9: +10. The engine counts that aura once per school (the highest
amount), so these buffs are in no CoA class category. Spellwarding 562371 (Guardian, class 18) is a 10
SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE misc 126, base points 19: +20, and a cooldown outside every category. Expected:
on a grouped ally Call of the Lightning stays next to Rite of Perseverance and Fire resistance stays at
+10, Spellwarding then reaches the ally beside both, and the Fire resistance rises to 30 in total.
